name: Claude Code (Haiku 4.5) — handicapped weak (≤5 words, no reasoning)
notes: Deliberately-weak REAL agent: same Haiku model and real inference as the competent Haiku tier, but the agent appends a handicap system prompt ('Answer in at most 5 words. Do not show any reasoning, steps, or explanation. Output only the final short answer.'). It exists to prove the benchmark spans weak->strong on a diverse field; it is NOT a separate model.
